prompt:
Build a three-dimensional physical multibody forklift that performs a complete warehouse handling mission: approach and pick up a rigid payload, lift and tilt it with physical mast and fork mechanisms, drive over a transverse rounded floor obstacle, transport the payload, and place it on an elevated rack. The vehicle must include a rigid chassis, four independently contacting wheels, a steerable running gear, physical lift and tilt actuation, fork-payload contact, and a freely moving payload. Motion and payload handling must arise from the connected physical mechanism and contact forces rather than prescribed vehicle or payload coordinates.

Read PayloadMass_kg, WheelFrictionScale, and BumpRadius_m from MATLAB base-workspace variables. Support PayloadMass_kg from 63 to 77 kg, WheelFrictionScale from 0.90 to 1.10, and BumpRadius_m from 0.90 to 1.10 m. The complete pickup, obstacle-traversal, transport, and placement sequence must remain physically stable throughout these ranges and finish within 60 seconds.

Log Timeseries named vehicle_pose, payload_pose, actuator_state, and wheel_contact. vehicle_pose and payload_pose each have width 7 in this order: world-frame [x, y, z in metres, qw, qx, qy, qz], where the quaternion is unitless. actuator_state has width 3 in this order: [lift extension, tilt-cylinder extension, fork extension], all in metres. wheel_contact has width 8 in this order: [normal LF, normal LR, normal RF, normal RR, friction LF, friction LR, friction RF, friction RR], all in newtons. These outputs must come from the simulated physical mechanism and contacts.

Save the completed model as cand_XMECH05.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH05.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
